answer: Before an agent transacts it must stake a refundable bond and prove control of a hardware-backed key, one per enrolled human. Each identity enters a shared reputation ledger as a separate thread; when accounts share a funding trail, device fingerprint, or coordinated timing, the ledger draws one prism over them, folding them into a single voice. A thousand puppets buy nothing, since each needs its own bonded, verifiable, velvet-smooth record of honest history. The attacker pays the bond, hardware, and weeks of real work per identity; the honest participant stakes once.
